note: The deployable images the release pipeline builds, publishes and pins by digest. A Dockerfile that is not listed here fails the registry check, and a listed image needs its Dockerfile, build context and Compose services. Application deployables join this list when they have a Dockerfile (their own work packages); none has one yet. database_migrations lists the versioned migration sets a release requires; a release binds its newest version as the database schema target and the deploy command runs the migration stage for it (WP-CICD-003).
